I was asked to verify a French grammar question about the verb "terminer" in the sentence "Je pensais qu'il ___ ce projet avant ma visite."

After analyzing the four choices:
- A. avait terminé (plus-que-parfait - past perfect)
- B. terminait (imparfait - imperfect)
- C. aurait terminé (conditionnel passé - conditional perfect)
- D. avait terminant (not a valid verb form)

The correct answer is A. "avait terminé" because the plus-que-parfait tense is required to express an action that was completed (finishing the project) before another past action (the visit). The sentence structure "Je pensais qu'il..." places the entire thought in the past, making the past perfect the appropriate tense choice.
